sevenTv.detail: Completes emotes (':' list, Tab carousel) and chatter names; adds 7TV's own '/' commands to Twitch's slash list. No '!' bot commands, no bot provider code, no issue or PR asking for it.
sevenTv.covers: emote and chatter completion, 7TV slash commands

ffz.detail: Core registers '!' prefix and a chat:get-tab-commands hook; official add-on 'Custom Commands Auto Completer' (iXyles, v1.0.0, 2026-02-01) fetches commands from StreamElements, Fossabot, Nightbot, Moobot.

evidence.note: api.streamelements.com, fossabot.com, api.nightbot.tv endpoints; Streamlabs excluded (CORS)
source applies only when bot detected in channel
only related issue: Filter Slash Commands

ffz.covers: free per-channel multi-bot '!' completion in Twitch web chat
ffz.misses: needs FFZ installed and the add-on enabled; no update since v1.0.0; not live-verified here

bttv.detail: 'Command Autocomplete' on '!' for Nightbot, Fossabot, Moobot, StreamElements, in releases through 7.7.28; gated to BTTV Pro (paid); data via BTTV backend cached/users/<provider>/<id>/autocomplete.

evidence.note: setting forced to default unless user.pro
Command Autocomplete setting with Pro badge

bttv.covers: full '!' popup with arguments, user levels, Tab/Enter, Twitch and YouTube
bttv.misses: paywalled (Pro + BTTV login); origin PR and public price not located

chatterino.detail: Desktop Qt client, not a browser extension. Completes Chatterino, custom, plugin and Twitch '/' commands; open PR #7289 adds a popup for '/' and '.' commands only.

evidence.note: command sources: Chatterino, custom, plugin, TWITCH_DEFAULT_COMMANDS
merged, command tab completion in replies

chatterino.misses: bot commands; not Twitch web chat

standalone.name: CommandMate
standalone.covers: per-stream command menu, not inline autocomplete

standalone.name: Library Twitch Command Buttons
standalone.covers: userscript helper library for chat input

standalone.name: ttv-chat
standalone.covers: separate chat client with a Nightbot service

standalone.name: Streamer.bot chat client
standalone.covers: desktop app; snippet says autocomplete includes '!' commands

verdict: Yes: BetterTTV (Pro-only, paid) and FrankerFaceZ via its free official add-on 'Custom Commands Auto Completer' already ship per-channel bot-command autocomplete in the Twitch web chat input; 7TV, Chatterino and the standalone tools found do not.
